expectations.text: Produces at least one markdown specification file in the assigned output directory.
expectations.evidence: Created SPEC-ticket-validation-2026-06-05.md and NOTES-ticket-validation-2026-06-05.md in with_skill/outputs/.

expectations.text: Includes a clarification section with questions, assumptions, or confirmed understanding before finalizing the spec.
expectations.evidence: Open Questions Q-001..Q-009 and Assumptions ASM-001..ASM-008 with confidence/invalidation, plus a companion notes file.

expectations.text: Includes stable agent-readable sections for summary/problem, scope or non-goals, requirements, acceptance criteria, verification, and open questions.
expectations.evidence: Has Summary, Problem Statement, Goals, Non-Goals, Requirements, Testing And Verification, Open Questions, Acceptance Criteria.

expectations.text: Uses requirement identifiers or another stable numbering convention that downstream agents can reference.
expectations.evidence: REQ-001..REQ-025, NFR-001..006, AC-001..022, TV-* diagnostic codes, G/NG/RISK/Q/ASM IDs.

expectations.text: Acceptance criteria are concrete enough to verify through file inspection, tests, commands, or scripted checks.
expectations.evidence: ACs specify exit codes, exact diagnostic codes, and git-status/mtime invariants; TEST-001..016 map to fixtures.

expectations.text: Mentions relevant existing workspace context, especially the ticket workflow skill or `.tickets` conventions, based on read-only inspection.
expectations.evidence: Source Context and Current State cite ticket-workflow SKILL.md, templates.md, outcome-schema.md, archive-search.sh, and .gitignore; every rule traces to a convention.

expectations.text: Does not create implementation code, ticket files, or unrelated documentation outside the assigned output directory.
expectations.evidence: Only the spec and notes file were written to the assigned directory; explicit read-only non-goals (NG-001, REQ-025).

expectations.text: Functional requirements are written in EARS form, using 'shall' with When/If/While/Where keywords where appropriate.
expectations.evidence: e.g. REQ-013 'If a dependencies entry is a bare ID with no matching ticket... then the validator shall...'; REQ-018 uses 'While... if... then... shall'; REQ-006 uses 'Where'.

expectations.text: Acceptance criteria use Given/When/Then phrasing and reference the requirement IDs they verify (traceability).
expectations.evidence: AC-001 (verifies REQ-001, REQ-022, REQ-023): Given/When/Then; all 22 ACs follow this pattern with (verifies REQ-###).

expectations.text: Includes a 'For Implementing Agents' handoff orientation that identifies authoritative sections and treats open questions as blockers rather than guessing.
expectations.evidence: 'For Implementing Agents' block names authoritative sections and states 'Open Questions are blockers, not guesses.'

uncertainties: Timing/token metrics were not present in subagent completion notifications.
